_meta.note: Values as stated by Brembo (brembo.com '5 facts' pages) or mirrors quoting Brembo. Upper/lower bounds ('<13 s', 'over 17 s') stored as the number with the qualifier in notes. powerKW = Brembo braking power at that corner. 2026 pages are pre-race simulations.
_meta.cards2026: 2026-11-22: all 21 Brembo 2026 F1 Brake Circuit Identity Cards (brembogroup.com/en/media/media-library, F1 brake circuits) added as card + corners; hardest = the corner Brembo names (5-facts page) or, where none is named (Spanish, Las Vegas), the card corner with the highest braking power. Brembo estimates (pre-race simulations), not measured. Bahrain Grand Prix 2026 = held at Sepang.

Italian Grand Prix.notes: 'just under 8 s'; decel 'at least 4.5 g'; pedal 'exceeds 140 kg'. No corner detail.

Chinese Grand Prix.notes: 18% stated as share of the race; zone count not stated (3 hard).

Austrian Grand Prix.notes: Polish Brembo page; per-lap pedal load just under 650 kg.

Belgian Grand Prix.notes: Polish Brembo page; 'over 12.5 s'; per-lap pedal load almost 1 t.

Mexico City Grand Prix.notes: 'brakes used in 9 of the 17 corners'; 3 hard, 2 medium.

Australian Grand Prix.notes: Brembo pre-season simulation reported by a mirror (brembo.com 2026 Australia page not reachable). 2025 T11: 4.8 g, 96 m, 1.80 s, 153 kg; 7 braking points in 2025 vs 4 expected in 2026.

Bahrain Grand Prix.notes: Page published before the event; 189 kg is far above every other 2026 figure (check).

Miami Grand Prix.notes: 'just under 10 s'; 2025 first corner per this page: 2,426 kW, 169 kg, 2.60 s, 117 m.

Canadian Grand Prix.notes: Mirror of Brembo preview; 'exceeding 14 s'. 2025 T10: 107 m, 2.82 s, 168 kg, 5 g.

Monaco Grand Prix.notes: 23% stated as share of the race.

Austrian Grand Prix.notes: 'at no point does deceleration reach 4 g'. 2025 T3: 112 m, 2.58 s, 4.6 g, 142 kg.

Hungarian Grand Prix.notes: 22% stated as share of the race; index 4 vs 3 in 2025.

Italian Grand Prix.notes: Italian mirror of Brembo data; '<8.5 s'. Index 3 vs 5 in 2025.

Singapore Grand Prix.notes: 24% stated as share of the race.

Mexico City Grand Prix.notes: Mirror; 'slightly less than 16 s'; max decel 'below 3.7 g'. 2025 T4: 4.1 g, 131 kg, 129 m, 2.76 s.

Spanish Grand Prix.notes: Madring. zones and 14.2 s are from the f1-fansite headline only (page not fetchable); 15% from scuderiafans.com/2026-f1-madrid-gp-preview-why-the-madring-could-make-mercedes-vulnerable-again/.

24 Hours of Le Mans.notes: Page URL says 2025 but text says 94th edition (= 2026). 20% stated as share of race; 757 kg is total pedal load per lap. maxPedalKg is the highest corner value stated (T8).

Rolex 24 at Daytona.notes: ~4,000 brake applications over 24 h (781 laps). GTD 2 g.

12 Hours of Sebring.notes: Source gives mph: '170 mph' -> '50 mph' (converted 274/80 km/h); 2,800-3,000 applications per race.
